page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.xlarge is an x86_64 server instance provisioned via KVM virtualization within the Shared family. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 8 vCPUs across 4 physical dedicated cores with two threads per core. Cache architecture consists of 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. The instance provides 32.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage is included, requiring network-attached storage, and no hardware GPUs are attached.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate moderate multithreaded capacity alongside modest single-core throughput. Synthetic CPU metrics report an average PassMark CPU score of 9,929.97 and average multi-core results in Geekbench (4,895.0) and stress-ng (8,682.55). In contrast, single-thread performance is bounded, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 907.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 18.97 GB/sec, placing both in the bottom decile. Memory metrics mirror this divergence: uncached read bandwidth reaches 61.2 GB/sec and write bandwidth hits 47.14 GB/sec, yet overall PassMark memory and database operation scores place in the bottom quartile. Redis SET performance maintains an average throughput of 10.22 million operations per second.

Given its balanced core-to-memory configuration alongside subdued single-threaded execution, ecs.n2.xlarge offers reasonable utility for horizontal, multithreaded services rather than latency-sensitive compute tasks. The absence of local disk drives indicates dependencies on network storage performance. It is suited for moderate enterprise middleware, background processing workers, distributed build systems, and general microservices that benefit from 8 vCPUs and 32 GB of memory without requiring high clock frequencies or accelerator hardware.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.xlarge is an x86_64 server instance based on the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It provides 8 vCPUs derived from 4 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM in a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. The configuration includes no local storage and no GPU accelerators. In benchmarks, the instance demonstrates average multithreaded compute throughput, posting a PassMark CPU score of 9,929.97, stress-ng multi-core performance of 8,682.55, and Redis SET rates of 10.22 million operations per second. However, single-core execution remains weak, characterized by low Geekbench single-thread marks and bottom-tier compression throughput. With average memory bandwidth and zero bundled disks, ecs.n2.xlarge functions effectively for general-purpose workloads, background data processing, software compilation, and scalable web tier components that leverage multiple concurrent threads.
